table.name: TLGNR_SAP_TRSP_MODE_BS
table.description: Transportation modes as expected by the LOGON->SAP Order Export Interface. 10=LKW/Truck, 50=Bahn/Train, 00=Ex Plant (Pickup).

column.name: SAP_TRSP_MODE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. Values are defined by SAP. 10=LKW/Truck, 50=Bahn/Train, 00=Ex Plant (Pickup). Note the leading zero for 00, therefore treat as text.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
